summary: Autolus Therapeutics plc filed an 8-K to announce the publication of its UK Annual Report and the distribution of notice for its upcoming annual general meeting (AGM) on June 29, 2026. The depositary for its ADSs began mailing voting materials to ADS holders. This is a routine shareholder communication and meeting notice with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring.
